meanings.en: to mock, to tease; colloquially 'are you kidding me?'
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'деваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are mocking, kidding', paired with 'поиздеваться'.

examples.trans: Are you kidding me?
